title: It Follows - HKZR Edition
description: This project add a following creature that follows you endlessly to kill the player
body: ![it_follows_title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6129bb21c4c08c1dad7387093f92e026e32c5509.png) # You can’t escape it anymore This mod brings the concept of _It Follows_ into Minecraft. An entity will start following you. Slowly. Constantly. It doesn’t stop, it doesn’t get lost, and now… it follows you across dimensions. The idea is loosely based on the mod used by Terracid (French streamer) in his _It Follows_ Minecraft speedruns. # V2 is out ## Features (V2) * An endlessly following entity that tracks you at all times * Persistent pressure: it will not lose your trail * Fast start: you only get a few seconds before it begins *** ## How it works (V2) * To start the chase, place a sign and write `i miss you` on one line, then break it * A sound will play, then the entity will spawn a few seconds later * If you change dimension, it will follow you *** ## Goal Kill the Ender Dragon and enter the portal before it reaches you. *** ## Notes * Designed for Hardcore / challenge runs * Works well in horror-focused modpacks *** ## After V2 * Further improvements to the entity (animations, behavior) * Bug fixes and performance improvements * Possible expansion of the end goal Suggestions are welcome. *** ## Credits * Mod developed by me * Original Dweller entity: idk\_someguy (used in V1) * [Terracid](https://www.twitch.tv/terracid) for the idea
